entry_points.text: Timestamp dispatcher routes atime versus combined ctime-mtime and rejects others with EIO; atime is no-op on equality else stores time; combined refreshes ctime always and mtime on change.

Open completion finalizes walks audits and enforces exclusion sticky and type checks with truncate under mount hold; tmpfile creates anonymous files; O-path resolves and opens; lookup transfers ownership, failing EBADF or ENOTDIR.
Kernel iterator writes require writable capable files with iterator and no plain write conflict, else EBADF or EINVAL; seeks require seekable else ESPIPE and delegate offset handling.

Collection derives machine flags and per-thread capacity, builds dumper chain and sizes process notes tolerating file-map omission; emission writes all present notes with process notes first, aborting on any failure.

exports.text: Dirty marking notifies filesystem hooks then queues first-dirty inodes with times and wakes delayed writeback; changes guard with per-inode lock and writeback list lock with temporary release.
Protected symlink check allows following on follower-owner match or when parent lacks sticky plus world-writable bits or dir owner matches; else EACCES with audit or RCU retry.
Cached child lookup samples rename sequence and retries on invalidation; containment takes mount read protection, climbs to root mount, then tests mount identity and ancestry.
Loader release drops saved executable file keeping wrapper; close during exec restores write access; format assignment swaps mm format with balanced module refs.
Kernel write wraps one bounded vector via iterator path; truncate validates length and serializes change; dump output is skip-aware bounded with power-of-two alignment.
Path rendering builds strings backwards into caller storage with custom formatters and deleted marks, failing ENAMETOOLONG on shortage; failfs test compares superblock identity.
Task register capture uses arch hook when present else generic copy guarded by size expectation.

hazards.text: Executable write deny uses atomic decrement while positive yielding text-busy races with bypass for storage manager modes; delegation wait needs prior presence then outer retry.

Errnos use ELOOP depth, EXDEV scoped xdev, ECHILD EAGAIN RCU retry, ENOTRECOVERABLE scoped root, ENOENT disconnect, EBADF dirfd, ENOMEM stack, ENOTDIR start, EACCES link, EIO timestamp; core uses ET_CORE PT_NOTE align 4 AT_NULL SHT_NULL SHN_UNDEF SEEK_CUR; arch rand zero, brk unchanged, read never implies exec.
External helpers for RCU seqlocks barriers atomics errors audit creds strings math prefetch freezer and warnings are owned elsewhere; this dossier relies only on call edges.

invariants.text: I_DIRTY_INODE absorbs I_DIRTY_TIME and never combines PAGES with TIME; queued or freeing stay put; lazytime selects TIME vs SYNC; version uses queried bit with stepped CAS, NOWAIT failing EAGAIN when bump required.
Only LAST_DOTDOT ascends clamped at walk root or via mountpoint with connectivity else ENOENT or EXDEV; unlink reveal needs same-mount advancing walk on mountable target.

Link depth caps at MAXSYMLINKS with embedded levels then full table copy, failing ELOOP or ENOMEM; component hash folds parent address and bytes via word-mix or byte accumulate with golden-ratio fold.

Fast open rejects create with slash and exclusive negative hits and forces follow plus directory on trailing slash; create needs mknod plus idmap plus dir write-exec plus auth including sticky rules; atomic open normalizes flags.

Create emits audit child then dirent, skipped without watchers; walk completion exits RCU and enforces scope with weak revalidation; truncate serializes zero-length change; personality thread and extra pages forward to arch.

Core image is consistent ET_CORE with PT_NOTE align 4; notes bind owner type payload extent; extnum uses null section; chained header name pad payload must all succeed; auxv and siginfo expose vector terminator and fatal details.

Prstatus and psinfo sample signals masks ids times and state with group versus task timing; files note lists file-backed maps with bounds growth retry and compaction; regset gating and release free only separate payloads.
Reverse prepend ignores overflowed buffers else preserves trailing fit and latches shortage with fault placeholders and separator; dump skip seeks when seekable else emits bounded zero pages.

locks.text: Mount write pairs sb start with mnt count and releases in reverse across mutation; killable inode lock propagates interrupt.

Root and pwd snapshots use exclusive seqlock against updates; parent lookup tries RCU grab then locks and revalidates pointer; path sampling runs under read protection with restart on rename or mount generation.

state_machines.text: Init validates flags and captures mount and rename sequences then selects preset root absolute cwd dirfd or scoped start in RCU or ref mode; mount-root crossing may fail EXDEV or ENOTRECOVERABLE.

Slow open holds parent lock exclusive for create else shared, validates dentry, tries atomic open else lookup then creates; delegation break waits and retries; final step merges intents, RCU residue forcing ECHILD retry with existence and type errors.
Dump first drains deferred skips once then appends only within limit without fatal signal or freeze, advancing offsets and counters; otherwise reports failure without partial accounting.

structs.text: ELF note descriptor holds name type length and payload with four-byte rounding; per-thread chain embeds status with trailing notes; collective state tracks process notes sizes and capacities.
Reverse buffers start at end of caller storage with latched negative remainder on overflow; extraction fails when overflowed; single char extend consumes space or latches.
